items.name: Moth shard
items.text: A second sliver of the Queen's heart-stone, pale gold where the first was red. It is cool until you hold it, and then it hums like a moth against a window.

items.name: The Court's mothlamp
items.text: A lantern of grey spider-silk and dew-glass. The flame inside is a tiny, patient moth made of light.

items.name: Dewcap tonic
items.text: Morning dew steeped with mushroom caps. It tastes of cold stone and mint and knits a scrape closed in a breath.

items.name: Glimmer honey
items.text: Thick amber honey that glows faintly in the jar. The bees that made it do not belong to any beekeeper.

items.name: Moonpetal
items.text: A white flower that only opens after dark. It smells like a cold, clean night.

items.name: Hollow-reed flute
items.text: A tiny flute cut by someone who cared. It plays one tune, and the tune is sad in a way you cannot name.

items.name: Mothsilk vest
items.text: Light as breath, grey and shot with silver. Arrows seem to forget where they were going.

items.name: Thistle-sting
items.text: A slim blade of black glass with a violet edge, light as a reed and just as quick.

items.name: Antler bow
items.text: A bow grown, not made, from a shed stag antler. It sings softly when drawn.

items.name: Dusk-stag hide
items.text: A heavy, dark pelt that smells of leaf mould. Wardens pay well for it.

items.name: Mirror-pool glass
items.text: A palm-sized sliver of water that has forgotten how to flow. It shows you a face that is almost yours.

items.name: Warden's oak-leaf token
items.text: A pressed bronze oak leaf. Wardens of the Whisperwood carry them; Tamsin gave you hers.
